scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A bride and groom hold hands in a sunlit stone courtyard as wedding guests and musicians celebrate. Jesus' mother is imagined as a head-covered woman in blue, with village houses and Galilean hills behind them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative rendering of the wedding in Cana of Galilee on the third day, with Jesus' mother present, as described in John 2:1. The figures and setting are imagined; the verse's English word glosses come from the Berean Interlinear Bible.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus and several disciples are welcomed by a man with open arms at a flower-decorated courtyard, where guests gather under a red-and-cream canopy.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Jesus and His disciples being invited to the wedding in John 2:2. The greeting, setting, and appearance of the people are artistic choices. The English token glosses are from the Berean Interlinear Bible, not GBT-approved glosses.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: At a wedding feast, Jesus' mother speaks to him beside an empty earthenware pitcher and cups, while guests gather in a sunlit courtyard.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 2:3, when the wine has run out and Jesus' mother tells him that they have no wine. The setting and gestures are artistic details. The source verse uses Nestle 1904 Greek and Berean Interlinear English token glosses; those glosses are not a Global Bible Tools approval.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks with open hands to Mary, who listens with clasped hands, beside clay jars and a small cup at a sunlit wedding gathering.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Jesus speaking to his mother in John 2:4, where he addresses her and says that his hour has not yet come. The gestures and visual details are imagined within the Cana wedding setting. The source's English word glosses are from the Berean Interlinear.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: At a flower-decorated wedding feast, Mary gestures toward Jesus while three servants look on beside large stone jars.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene relates to John 2:5, where Jesus' mother tells the servants to do whatever he says. The appearance of the people and setting is an artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Six large carved stone water jars stand in a sunlit courtyard beside a shallow washing basin and a folded cloth.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene inspired by John 2:6, which describes six stone water jars for the Jewish custom of purification, each with room for two or three metretes. The courtyard, basin, cloth, and decorative details are imagined. The chapter's English token glosses are from the Berean Interlinear Bible, not GBT-approved glosses.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures toward six large stone jars in a sunny wedding courtyard while a servant pours clear water into one; other servants stand beside the water-filled jars.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene inspired by John 2:7: Jesus tells them to fill the jars with water, and they fill them to the brim. The six stone jars come from the preceding verse, John 2:6; the courtyard and figures are artistic interpretation. The English word glosses are from the Berean Interlinear Bible.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures beside large stone jars while a servant lifts a filled cup from one jar and another carries a small vessel toward the seated master of the feast. Guests gather at tables beneath grapevines.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 2:8: Jesus tells them to draw some out and carry it to the master of the feast, and they carry it. The scene's appearance and arrangement are artistic choices. The verse's English token glosses are from the Berean Interlinear Bible.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: At a wedding feast, a man holding a cup of wine gestures toward the bridegroom while two servants stand beside large water jars.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects John 2:9: after tasting water that had become wine, the master of the feast, unaware of its source, calls the bridegroom, while the servants who drew the water know. The setting, appearances, gestures, and moment are artistic choices. The chapter's English word glosses are from the Berean Interlinear and are not a Global Bible Tools approval.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: At a wedding feast, a bearded steward in a red robe holds a cup of wine and speaks to the smiling bridegroom. Guests dine beneath flowering vines, while a clay jug, cups, grapes, and dishes fill the foreground.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of John 2:10: the master of the feast tells the bridegroom he has kept the good wine until now, although good wine is usually served first and inferior wine after guests have drunk freely. John 2:9 identifies the speaker and the bridegroom. The setting and appearances are imagined. The chapter's English word glosses are uncurated Berean Interlinear glosses, not GBT-approved glosses.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stands with attentive disciples beside large stone jars while a servant pours red wine into a cup at a wedding feast in a sunlit courtyard.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene places Jesus and his disciples at the wedding in Cana, with the stone jars and wine from John 2:1–10. John 2:11 describes this first sign as revealing his glory and says his disciples believed in him. The chapter's English word glosses are from the Berean Interlinear Bible.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus walks down a rocky path beside His mother and four companions toward stone houses by a blue lake.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: John 2:12 tells that Jesus went down to Capernaum with His mother, His brothers, and His disciples, and that they stayed there not many days. This imaginative scene depicts their arrival; the landscape, appearances, and number of companions are artistic choices. The chapter's English word glosses are from the Berean Interlinear and are not a Global Bible Tools approval.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus walks along a stony road toward Jerusalem, with other travelers and the temple visible in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: John 2:13 describes Passover drawing near and Jesus going up to Jerusalem. This is an imaginative depiction; the road, travelers, and appearance of the city are illustrative details. The token glosses are from the Berean Interlinear.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stands in a sunlit temple courtyard among sellers and fenced oxen and sheep. Doves gather in cages beside a seller, while money changers sit at tables with coins and scales.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Jesus finding sellers of oxen, sheep, and doves and seated money changers in the temple, as described in John 2:14 and its Berean Interlinear word glosses.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus raises a whip of cords in a temple courtyard as sheep and oxen run past and money changers recoil beside an overturned table and scattered coins.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts John 2:15, where Jesus drives sheep and oxen from the temple with a whip made of cords, spills the money changers' coins, and overturns their tables. The English word glosses are from the Berean Interlinear and are not a GBT approval.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures toward dove sellers in a sunlit temple courtyard as one man lifts a cage of white doves and another looks on.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This is an imaginative portrayal of Jesus telling the dove sellers to take these things away and not make his Father's house a house of trade, informed by the chapter's Berean Interlinear Bible token glosses.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stands firmly beside an overturned table and scattered coins in a temple courtyard while three disciples watch him, one with a hand on his chest. Doves fly near the table, and people and sheep appear among the pale stone columns.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene places the disciples' remembrance of the written words about zeal for God's house in the setting of Jesus clearing the temple. Their gestures and expressions are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone temple courtyard, a man gestures toward Jesus as several others look on. An overturned table and scattered coins lie between them, with animals and sellers in the background.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of John 2:18, where the Jewish people ask Jesus what sign He shows them for doing these things. The temple courtyard and overturned table recall the preceding verses; the visual details are imagined. The English word glosses are from the Berean Interlinear Bible.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stands among listeners in a sunlit temple courtyard, one hand against his chest and the other raised, with three pools of light on the paving stones.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Jesus answering in the temple. The three pools of light suggest his words about raising the temple in three days; John 2:21 identifies the temple as his body.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit temple courtyard, a man holds up three fingers as he speaks to Jesus, while others look on and an ornate stone temple stands behind them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined courtyard conversation reflects John 2:20's question about the temple built over forty-six years and whether Jesus would raise it in three days. The gestures and setting are artistic interpretation, based on the verse and its Berean Interlinear word glosses.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks to listeners in a sunlit temple courtyard, with one hand on his chest and the other extended; the Jerusalem temple stands behind him.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests John 2:21's meaning: Jesus was speaking about the temple of his body. The verse does not specify this gesture or the arrangement shown.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Five disciples gather around an unlettered scroll in a sunlit garden, with an open rock-hewn tomb and its rolled-away stone behind them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the disciples recalling Jesus' words and believing Scripture after he was raised from the dead. The garden gathering and scroll are artistic choices, not details specified in John 2:22.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stands in a sunlit Jerusalem courtyard among a crowd of people looking toward him; a soft golden glow surrounds his open hand.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for John 2:23: during the Passover feast in Jerusalem, many believed in Jesus' name as they saw the signs he was doing. The glow is an artistic suggestion; the verse does not identify the signs.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stands with his hands held together in a sunlit stone courtyard, looking thoughtfully toward a group of attentive people.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests Jesus' discernment and reserve as John 2:24 says He did not entrust Himself to them because He knew all people. The chapter's English word glosses are from the Berean Interlinear Bible, not a GBT approval.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus looks attentively at a seated man while a woman and three other men watch in a sunlit stone courtyard.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of John 2:25: Jesus needed no one to testify about a person, because he himself knew what was within people.
